name: x2611_14754_thm1_1_prime
statement: (n d p k : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 1 < n) (hd : 1 < d) (hp : p.Prime) (hk : 0 < k) (hdiv : p ^ k ∣ n) (hmax : ¬ p ^ (k + 1) ∣ n) (hsmall : p ^ k < 2 ^ d) : ¬ ∃ S : Finset (Fin d → ZMod n), S.card = n ^ (d - 1) ∧ x2611_14754_nonattacking S
closed: ∀ (n d p k : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 1 < n) (hd : 1 < d) (hp : p.Prime) (hk : 0 < k) (hdiv : p ^ k ∣ n) (hmax : ¬ p ^ (k + 1) ∣ n) (hsmall : p ^ k < 2 ^ d), ¬ ∃ S : Finset (Fin d → ZMod n), S.card = n ^ (d - 1) ∧ x2611_14754_nonattacking S
original:
Suppose that the prime factorization of $n$ contains a prime power $q$ which is less than $2^{d}$ .
Then one cannot place $n^{d-1}$ non-attacking queens on $(\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z})^{d}$ .
